design: raster_window.py preserves interpreted uint8 RGB/grey bytes and palette colours; other bands use bounded whole-source overview percentiles, never crop percentiles.

Direct windows return RASTER_STRETCH_PENDING until the header exists. Legacy/stable first crops can use the same bounded whole-source overview as fallback.
raster-publication.ts forwards and verifies stretch pins, including refusal of a missing pin in the reply; implicit and explicit step 1 windows compare equally.
Contracts label all stretches display_only. Null limits remain null, nodata stays transparent, original bytes and unscaled metadata statistics remain unchanged.
